entities.summary: Kimmo Ilpo Juhani Laiho, better known by his stage name Elastinen, is a Finnish rapper and also one of the founders and CEO of independent Finnish rap label Rähinä Records. Together with his colleague Iso H, he founded the Finnish rap duo Fintelligens. He has released five solo albums.
